retained_changes: Derive wire power on reads when every wire has no fixed, conditional or side electrical outputs. Keep eager fallback for all other circuits.
Skip the preliminary switched-wire refresh walk and residual ordinary-wire refreshes in deferred mode.
Keep deferred unwatched wires out of switched-node lists; retain input accounting and watched-wire, piston-head and observer callbacks.

benchmark_protocol.order: Alternating pairs; reverse order on the second pair. One active engine at a time.
benchmark_protocol.scope: Same frozen relaxed Program and native16-game-tick batches, including equal Python dispatch overhead. Compilation, preparation, controls, publication, state reads and correctness checks excluded from timer. Baseline is the previous eager runtime with only wire-flag acceptance and API version adapted to match the current encoder.

native_counted_operations.scope: Native internal work counter; not a game-tick numerator or cross-engine metric.

current_rust_wrapper_check.scope: Fresh compiled Program with actual --relaxed and --samples=1 options, one Rust Compiler.tick call per game tick. CPU24. Single confirmation sample, not a paired speedup estimate.

validation.fpu_scope: Existing FPU protocol:128 seeded control changes over10000 ticks; opcode mask2. Clock-specific falling-edge parity and exhaustive arithmetic coverage not established.

default_mode_validation.scope: Same original strict Program in prior and current DLLs, compared after timing. Default semantic behavior remains eager.

limits: Rates are kernel measurements; live server publication, networking and client rendering were not benchmarked.
Relaxed mode can change transient wire power/shape behavior. Passed circuit protocols do not establish universal engine equivalence.
Custom native DLLs must match semantic version34. Existing running servers and custom target/native_engine.dll were not replaced.
